title: gloss-signature/v3
description: nodes/<id>/gloss/signed/<hash>-<n>.yaml or targets/<id>/gloss/signed/<hash>-<n>.yaml (F20-R8; D-3 v3.30): a steward's or curator's signature on one gloss version, affirming one sentence — I have read this against the Lean it names, and it says what the Lean says. It changes no grade, status or digestion state. Signed with the signer's own SSH key over the canonical body (opn_gate.signed), as explainer signatures are. v2 adds sections: a signature approves the sections it names (F21-R13, D-3 v3.31).  v3 adds `via` (F23-R10, R11; D-3 v3.33): the signature may be made through the service with the network's approval key for a signed-in steward or curator, and means what an SSH signature means. Versioned, never edited (D-34).

node.description: The node, or null for a definition module's gloss.

gloss.description: The SHA-256 of the gloss file signed — its name under gloss/.

signer.description: The signer's GitHub login. At Stage 0 a real-identity contributor is an active steward of the target or a listed curator (F15-Q4).

via.description: How the signature was made (D-3, D-32 v3.33): `ssh`, by the signer's own SSH key; `approval-key`, by the network's approval key through the service, for a login signed in with GitHub on the site, in which case `key` must equal the graph's keys/approval.pub in the merge's parent tree.

sections.description: The sections this signature approves and verifies (F21-R13; D-3 v3.31), by key; absent approves every section of the version.

items.description: A section's key (F21-R11): overview for an explainer's unanchored first section, whole for a gloss, else steps: and the section's step ids, sorted, comma-separated.
